note: Triennial election of the rural district council (29 divisions), 1964: sixteen contests at the close of nominations, fifteen after the withdrawal of Bernard Murphy in Belleek, polled 4 June 1964. Polled 4 June 1964, counted 5 June. Trainor was the sitting member. Malachy Trainor: no party label printed in 1964. At other elections he stood as Independent Labour (South Armagh, Parliament of Northern Ireland, 31 May 1962, listed as Independent Labour).
